description: Check a saved test again now, by its name (or a feature's, or tags), or every switched-on test of the app. Answers with the verdict and the report.

presentation.description: How the passed check is filmed. { layout: 'landing' } makes a 16:10 film with the app filling the frame, for a website, plus a short muted loop; add captions: true to draw captions. Leave it out for the usual film.

captions.description: With 'landing': draw the captions, small, at the bottom. Off unless true.

layout.description: 'landing': a 16:10 film with the app filling the frame, for a website, plus a short muted loop. 'call' (the default): the usual film.

repo.description: The app, as "owner/name". Left out, the workspace's only app.

tags.description: Check only the switched-on tests carrying these tags. Send either `test` or `tags`, not both.

test.description: The one test or feature to check, by its name as about_app lists it. Left out, every switched-on test of the app.

name: check_test
